items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: I think was Red Norvo there, I can’t remember.

ctx.x: What made you decide to do it, and what can we expect to learn about Bill Evans? You don’t have to give away all your good stuff but —

Oh that’s okay, I don’t mind sharing a couple of things. But the reason I wanted to do it was because these stories were fresh in my mind starting in, you know, 1980 after he passed. And I just kept re-experiencing them and mulling them over. So sometime in the ‘90s I started to write them down. And then they were just kind of compiling and I would have different episodes of things. And when I had enough material together I reached out to one of my former graduate students who was older, Charles Levin. And…
That’s interesting, almost like a reporter who needs to get confirmation about their stories.
